title: Why Don't Woodpeckers Get Concussions? 🪵 #Shorts
description:
Woodpeckers slam their heads into trees at 1,200 Gs yet don't get concussions. Their tiny 2-gram brain keeps the pressure inside the skull below concussion level — being small IS the helmet.
